svg.title: The 120 unit icosians: the 600-cell
svg.desc: The 120 vertices of the 600-cell, which are the 120 unit icosians and the root system of H4, projected from 4-D to the plane with the Coxeter-plane projection. The 120 points fall on four concentric rings of 30 with 30-fold symmetry, joined by the 720 edges between vertices at distance one over phi. Depth is shown by opacity.
svg.text: During training each step's rotation u_t can be snapped to the nearest of these 120 unit icosians — an exact, finite codebook.
Each vertex has 12 neighbours: 120 × 12 / 2 = 720 edges. Fainter points and edges lie farther out of the plane.
